newsitem.title: LATVIA: PARLIAMENT TO INVESTIGATE UNIBANKA PRIVATISATION.
newsitem.headline: PARLIAMENT TO INVESTIGATE UNIBANKA PRIVATISATION.

text.p: Parliament decided on Monday to form a commission to investigate the privatisation of leading bank Unibanka and Savings Bank (Krajbanka), which is currently in the process of being sold.
The comission, representing all parliament's factions, has to hand in its conclusions by May 1.
The MPs responsible for proposing the commission allege that wrongdoings and abuses took place during the sale of Unibanka.
The bank's managers point out that it has already been investigated by all the relevant state bodies, including the State Audit.
Some 40 MPs, including the leading Democratic Party Saimnieks and the Christian Democrats, have been calling for the commission for some time.
